definitions.gloss: royalty, royal family, members of the royal family
definitions.explanation: The family or relatives of a king or queen. Refers collectively to people of royal blood or the royal lineage as a group. Used for both historical and contemporary monarchies.

examples.japanese: {王族|おうぞく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦パレード→パレード：11293_pareedo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: Members of the royal family participated in the parade.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{王族|おうぞく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{敬|うやま}われている→敬う：00417_uyamau⟧。
examples.english: The royal family of that country is deeply respected by the people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{王族|おうぞく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国外|こくがい}→国外：20936_kokugai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追放|ついほう}→追放：14313_tsuihou⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、{王政|おうせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The royal family was exiled abroad by the revolution, and the monarchy was abolished.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {王族|おうぞく}: royalty, members of a king's family — used broadly for any monarchy
- ⟦{皇族|こうぞく}→皇族：22657_kouzoku⟧: members of the Imperial family — specifically for the Japanese Emperor's family
- ⟦{王室|おうしつ}→王室：15297_oushitsu⟧: royal house/household — emphasizes the institution rather than the people

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {王族|おうぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一員|いちいん}→一員：08920_ichiin⟧: a member of the royal family
- {王族|おうぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: of royal blood
- {王族|おうぞく}⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧: exclusive to royalty
